verdict.rationale: Marqeta is a card-issuing/payments API platform, not an AI agent or assistant application that hosts/consumes external tools. Its only MCP-related capability is the reverse: exposing its own Core API as an MCP server for other agents to call (marqeta-docs-11, marqeta-probe-4), not accepting MCP servers as plug-ins itself. This axis (product acting as MCP client/host) is a category error for this type of product.
